name: arpi-deployment-tooling
description: Railway deployment tooling for Automotive Retail Performance Intelligence (ARPI). Not the website — that is portfolio/. This package exists because Railway's Infrastructure as Code runner resolves `railway/iac` from the repository root, and because `.railway/railway.ts` is TypeScript that has to type-check against that SDK.
//dependencies: The Railway CLI is deliberately NOT a dependency here. It is a tool this repository invokes, not a library it links, and taking it as an npm dependency pulls in `tar@6` — which carries a critical advisory that cannot be overridden, because `tar@7` removed the default export its postinstall imports. The CLI version is pinned instead in deployment/railway/tooling.json and resolved at run time by scripts/railway/lib/cli.ts, which keeps the pin reviewable in a diff without putting a vulnerable transitive dependency in this lockfile. `npm audit` on this package reports zero findings at any level as a result.
author: Michael Palmer

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run spec:validate && npm run iac:evaluate
